title: Turing hiring remote illustrators and concept artists
content: TURING IS LOOKING FOR ARTISTS — FRESHERS CAN APPLY! If you’re an Illustrator, Sketcher, Cartoonist, Digital Artist or Concept Artist, check this opportunity. Fully remote. Paid in USD per approved task. Part-time welcomed. Portfolio required. Payment: Easy — $2/task (~30 mins); Medium — $3/task (~35 mins); Hard — $4.05/task (~40 mins). Interns, freshers, emerging artists and experienced professionals are welcome. Tools: Photoshop, Illustrator, Procreate, Clip Studio Paint or similar. Apply via portfolio review then onboarding if approved. Contact: reply or DM @thecvcook; application link was posted on the X post.
